Entries.Original: Excellent work.
Praise, at long last!
However, your tactics are still haphazard at best. I know you are capable of more refined combat.
You still have a long way to go. If this were active combat, you would be dead.
If this is the best you can do, tomorrow's aptitude test will be all but impossible.
She's angry for once!
For once? Did you forget all the other times?
There is still time. I want you to train like your life depends on it today.
Yeah, we still have a ton of room to grow. We're all so young!
You must be doing this on purpose.
May I continue? The stronger your enemies are, the more essential healing becomes.
When forming your squad, you must be mindful of both damage output and defensive capabilities.
Healing, huh? Cappy, you're on deck! Soon as we have free time, it's you and me in the arena!
Why just the two of us? Isn't it better if the whole squad is there?
Well, when you start putting marriage on the table, spending quality time together becomes more important than ever before.
But if you're already happy together, why would you need to worry about that?
That's the problem with love—it's never that simple.
Once you hit the three-year mark, you fall into a rut, and one side or the other tends to want to break up. They have a term for this, the three-year itch.
We can't pretend it won't happen to us. After three years, my beloved Cappy might leave my side, and then we won't have a healer.
We need to take our relationship seriously starting now, so we can make it past that hurdle when the time comes.
I see, I see. We need to build a solid foundation so our relationship doesn't fall apart in three years! It all makes sense now!
That's my Cappy, quick on the uptake.
But we're not dating!
What?
I said we're not dating!
That's true, we're not.
So none of what you said makes any sense!
Correctomundo! Nice hacking, Cappy!
I'm the hacker, dum-dum.
The aptitude test is coming up tomorrow.
Use your free time wisely, and do not slack off on training.
That concludes today's training. Good work, everyone.
